articles.title: Former FTX Europe chief targets U.S. tokenized stock trading with new SEC exemption
articles.snippet: Nasdaq-listed Perpetuals.com is the second company to pursue a U.S. tokenized stock marketplace under the SEC's new framework, following a joint venture between OKX and NYSE parent ICE.

articles.title: America's growing digital economy requires power grid updates. Who will foot the bill?
articles.snippet: Congress must decide how the U.S. can build the infrastructure its booming digital economy requires while protecting the communities that host it.

articles.title: Dutch central bank grants Qivalis e-money license for MiCA-compliant euro token
articles.snippet: Backed by BBVA, BNP Paribas, and ING, Qivalis secured Dutch regulatory authorization to offer onchain euro settlement infrastructure.

articles.title: S&P 500 options are the hottest bet on this Hyperliquid exchange
articles.snippet: Hypercall, an exchange built on Hyperliquid, says most of its $640 million in volume since June has come from the index.

articles.title: Coinbase, which holds 5% of all bitcoin, wants the quantum fix started now
articles.snippet: Coinbase says bitcoin should start preparing for quantum computers now, with flexible addresses, a backup quantum-proof key and a separate debate over lost coins.
